# README Banner

The banner follows the illustrated cover format used by Wordsmith Engine,
personalitygen, and Release Notes Scribe. It is promotional artwork, not a
screenshot of Ship Shape output.

- File: `ship_shape_social_preview.jpg`.
- Dimensions: 1280 by 640 pixels.
- Generation tool: built-in `image_gen`.
- Conversion: JPEG at quality 90, scaled to 1280 pixels wide with `sips`.
- Visible title: `Ship Shape`.
- Public README link:
  `![Ship Shape banner](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/btfranklin/ship-shape/main/.github/social%20preview/ship_shape_social_preview.jpg "Ship Shape")`.

The public image URL uses the repository's `main` branch.
See [the release guide](../../docs/RELEASING.md) for the publication checklist.

## Generation Prompt

```text
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: illustrated GitHub repository banner and README cover, wide landscape composition.
Create original art for "Ship Shape", a TypeScript Canvas 2D toolkit that generates capital spaceships and detailed hull panels, pipes, equipment, windows, and engines.
Style: richly illustrated technical science-fiction cover, fine engraved linework, restrained paper grain, the finish of an illustrated engineering book. Match the general treatment of a polished open-source project banner: a clear large project title with domain-specific art.
Scene: a large modular capital spaceship seen from above, horizontal across the right side of the cover, with layered hull sections, rings, storage modules, surface panels, small illuminated windows, and cyan engine light. A few quiet construction lines and smaller hull detail studies suggest how simple shapes form a complete vessel. Deep midnight-blue background, warm ivory linework and title, subtle muted copper accents. Calm and precise; avoid a battle scene.
Composition: broad cover, about 2:1 aspect ratio, with title on the left and ship on the right; keep important content away from edges. Let the artwork support the title without covering it.
Text (verbatim): "Ship Shape". This is the only text. Large, exceptionally clear title, readable at thumbnail size. No slogan, badges, code, watermarks, or unrelated logos.
The image is promotional artwork, not a screenshot of the library's output.
```
